title: Magical Duck Wizard
description: A white anthropomorphic duck with glowing purple eyes stands in the center of a narrow European cobblestone alley. The duck wears a blue wizard hat decorated with stars and emits swirling, luminous purple and blue magical energy from its body and wings.
prompt: Anthropomorphic white duck with glowing purple eyes wearing a blue wizard hat with stars, standing in an old narrow European alley with yellow and pink stucco buildings, cobblestone ground, potted flowers on the walls, the duck surrounded by swirling luminous purple and blue magical energy trails and sparkles, painterly style with visible brush strokes, vibrant warm color palette
